citations.title: Security by Design | Scandit
excerpts: **Certification and governance**
Scandit is ISO 27001:2022 Certified and has a dedicated information security team and executive-level oversight committee.
**Product and data security**
All image processing is performed on the scanning device itself to ensure high availability and confidentiality.\* Any data you choose to share with us is encrypted both during transit and at rest.
**Infrastructure security**
Data you choose to send us is protected by both Scandit’s security expertise and the protection provided by industry-leading multi-certified cloud service providers.

### Certification and governance

**Certification and compliance:** Scandit is [ISO 27001:2022 Certified](https://www.certipedia.com/certificates/01+153+2400165%252F01?locale=en) \*\* — an independently audited, globally recognised enterprise-grade international standard for information security, cyber security, and privacy. Of course, we also comply with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and CCPA.
